Standard: The air vehicle's lateral control in forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) steady sideslips is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Lateral Control in Steady Sideslips paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the lateral control in steady sideslips as specified in MIL-DTL- 32742, Lateral Control in Steady Sideslips paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. From a trimmed steady heading sideslip, verify that left sideslip does not require right lateral control displacement and force (and vice-versa) and that the variation of lateral control displacement and force with sideslip is essentially linear. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the lateral control in steady sideslips as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Lateral Control in Steady Sideslips paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. From a trimmed steady heading sideslip, verify that left sideslip does not require right lateral control displacement and force (and vice-versa) and that the variation of lateral control displacement and force with sideslip is essentially linear. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the lateral control in steady sideslips as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Lateral Control in Steady Sideslips paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. From a trimmed steady heading sideslip, verify that left sideslip does not require right lateral control displacement and force (and vice-versa) and that the variation of lateral control displacement and force with sideslip is essentially linear.
